page.content:
Council of elders that steered the Republic and lent the Empire its language.

How Roman Senate connects

  • Concept: SPQR — SPQR names the Senate together with the Roman people.
  • Faction: Roman Republic — The Senate was the steering council of the Republic.
  • Character: Cicero — Cicero was a consular voice of the Senate.
  • Character: Romulus — Legend has Romulus choosing the first senators.

What is Roman Senate?

The Senate advised magistrates, assigned provinces, and embodied mos maiorum. Emperors packed and flattered it; SPQR still named the Senate and People as the state's fiction.

Key threads lead to SPQR, Roman Republic, Cicero and Romulus.
